US Report Flags India for Aiding China's Tariff Evasion

A United States report has identified India among dozens of countries suspected of facilitating China's evasion of US tariffs. The report, which cites a "transshipment scam," claims tens of billions of dollars in annual revenue are lost due to goods being moved through lower-tariff nations. The US has placed India in a Tier 1 category for "shadow trade" risk, indicating a heightened concern over this practice. This development occurs amidst ongoing US-China trade tensions and broader global trade dynamics.
